description: Attribute every edit a session makes to one person: name them once, and each node written afterwards is credited to them as its author. They must already be a Contributor. Credit only — never an approval. One call can name someone else in its `_meta` under `reflow2/writes_for`, the only way when no session is kept. Omit contributor_id to stop.

acting_agent.description:
The AGENT this session writes THROUGH — a `Contributor` of kind
`automated_agent` (e.g. `who:claude-code`), recorded beside the person
on every authorship and approval the session records, and drawn
`ACTS_FOR` them. Attribution only: it never signs anything. It must
already exist. Omit it to name no agent (a Contributor whose `handle`
equals this client's name is still found).

contributor_id.description:
The `Contributor` this session writes for — the PERSON when there is
one, or a project (e.g. `who:<project>`) for writes no person made. It
must already exist; `add_contributor` first. Omit it, or pass null, to
stop crediting this session's writes to anyone.

name: writes_for
